release_notes: OLED 2.42 beta build 72. Corrects blank OLED and faint buzzer behaviour following a software restart during an active alarm. Forces GPIO25 LOW immediately at startup, resets the tone output, recovers the software I2C bus before SSD1309 initialization, adds a controlled restart sequence, and delays alarm-audio activation until the OLED and Nightscout state are stable. Moves the cloud-alert and alarm-audio tasks to Core 0 to reduce interference with the OLED software-I2C processing on Core 1. Retains the FreeRTOS cloud-alert queue, dedicated buzzer task, fixed setup hotspot, daily insulin and carbohydrate treatment tables, Nightscout SAGE, IOB and COB support, Wi-Fi profiles and caregiver WhatsApp routing.
